import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec3, vec4, mix, texture } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry } = ctx.THREE;

  const container = new Group();
  const timeline = gsap.timeline();
  const activePrimitives = [];

  // Stage Backdrop: high-contrast dark gradient to avoid FLAT_VOID
  const backdropGeo = new PlaneGeometry(8, 6.5);
  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  
  const vUv = uv();
  const inkColor = vec3(0.086, 0.086, 0.114);    // #16161d
  const surfaceColor = vec3(0.043, 0.043, 0.063); // #0b0b10
  const accentColor = vec3(1.0, 0.165, 0.22);     // #ff2a38

  // Rich procedural vignette and accent bleed
  const radialGlow = vUv.distance(vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)).oneMinus().smoothstep(0.4, 1.0).mul(0.15);
  const backdropGradient = mix(inkColor, surfaceColor, vUv.y).add(accentColor.mul(radialGlow));
  backdropMat.colorNode = vec4(backdropGradient, 1.0);

  const backdrop = new Mesh(backdropGeo, backdropMat);
  backdrop.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);
  container.add(backdrop);

  // Content Sprite Group
  const cardGroup = new Group();
  container.add(cardGroup);

  // Aspect ratio 512x320 = 1.6
  const width = 1.6 * 1.3;
  const height = 1.0 * 1.3;
  const cardGeo = new PlaneGeometry(width, height);
  const cardMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true });

  const cardMesh = new Mesh(cardGeo, cardMat);
  cardGroup.add(cardMesh);

  // Dynamic image loading
  if (config.imageUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl).then((tex) => {
      cardMat.colorNode = texture(tex);
      cardMat.needsUpdate = true;
    }).catch(err => {
      console.warn('Prism: Texture load overlay failed, falling back to clean plate', err);
      cardMat.colorNode = vec4(surfaceColor, 0.9);
    });
  } else {
    cardMat.colorNode = vec4(surfaceColor, 0.9);
  }

  // Load Copy Overlay
  const textItems = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const headlineCopy = textItems.find(t => t.role === 'headline' || t.role === 'title')?.text ?? "Collection 1";

  const textLabel = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(headlineCopy, {
    fontSize: 0.13,
    color: '#e8ecf2', // paper tone
    align: 'center'
  });
  textLabel.position.set(0, -0.15, 0.05);
  cardGroup.add(textLabel);

  // Apply visual transitions & subtle movement
  timeline.to(cardGroup.position, {
    y: '+=0.04',
    duration: 3.5,
    ease: 'sine.inOut',
    repeat: -1,
    yoyo: true
  });

  gsap.fromTo(cardGroup.scale, 
    { x: 0.92, y: 0.92, z: 0.92 },
    { x: 1.0, y: 1.0, z: 1.0, duration: 1.2, ease: 'power3.out' }
  );

  // Apply dynamically passed cinematic primitives automatically 
  const primitivesToApply = config.cinematicPrimitives ?? [];
  primitivesToApply.forEach((prim) => {
    if (ctx.primitives && typeof ctx.primitives[prim.name] === 'function') {
      const instance = ctx.primitives[prim.name](cardGroup, prim.params);
      if (instance) activePrimitives.push(instance);
    }
  });

  // Mandatory clean resources implementation inside returned object
  container.userData = {
    handlers: {},
    cleanup: () => {
      // Decomission active GSAP elements
      timeline.kill();
      gsap.killTweensOf(cardGroup.position);
      gsap.killTweensOf(cardGroup.scale);

      // Clean primitives assets
      activePrimitives.forEach((prim) => {
        if (typeof prim.cleanup === 'function') prim.cleanup();
      });

      // Purge 3D GPU targets
      cardGeo.dispose();
      cardMat.dispose();
      backdropGeo.dispose();
      backdropMat.dispose();
    }
  };

  return container;
}
